next_step_summary: PR #276 is a bounded corrective follow-up to PR #275 after a freshly downloaded main still printed Streamlit bare-mode and Google GenAI AFC advisory warnings. Root causes: Streamlit logging initialization occurred after the earlier logger-level assignment, and google-genai actually emits the AFC advisory from logger `google_genai.models`, not `google.genai.models`. PR #276 imports Streamlit before applying CLI-only logger thresholds, sets the Streamlit parent/specific bare-mode logger to ERROR, and targets the actual Google GenAI logger. Provider routing, retry cycles, Question Engine extraction/validation, privacy gates, OCR scope, report persistence, model list, dependencies, permissions, workflows, endpoints and network destinations are unchanged. The canonical next step remains `question-engine-single-contract-real-rerun-v4`: rerun the same reviewed March-August 2025 contract and inspect explicit answers for `security.realization_chain`, `security.return_mechanics`, `security.completion_authority`, `termination.notice_cure`, and `termination.cross_clause_interaction` before broadening to other contracts.
